description: The main window may invoke only commands declared in the application ACL manifest: production library and resource commands, the four probe commands, and the three M2-AC1 acceptance commands. RC-4 history, restore, and rerender commands, the M2-PAGE-RESOURCE-RESOLVE-1 page resolve, the M2-PAGE-NAV-PROJECTION-1 page navigation projections, and HOST-ISSUER-1 user actions are production-only. HostControl remains internal to Rust stdio.
